# Colour profile fixture

`DisplayP3-v4.icc` comes from Compact ICC Profiles by Clinton Ingram
(https://github.com/saucecontrol/Compact-ICC-Profiles, commit
`bdd84663061bc4ae95ca70decff54f581e27f702`), dedicated to the public domain under
CC0 1.0. SHA-256 `cb51de38e482ee974c0c76b9689e16aad04bad16e226fed2f30c842d15ff3a3d`.
It lets tests build a Display P3 photo like the ones recent phones produce.
